scientific_integrity: Earlier one-particle density and master equation credited to Grange. New critical pair classification has same-model analytical review only; priority remains subject to independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Mean-field stationary fitness model, strictly subcritical hopping parameter, 0<nu<1; sequential large-site, continuum and critical-removal limits. The observable is a normalized ordered within-site factorial moment and not global population variance.
title: Premature same-site pair crowding under fitness-dependent local resetting
